result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide, well-maintained sidewalks. However, the crossing distance across the multi-lane roadway is significant and lacks a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a mid-point refuge island.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.
